content:
Because it doesn’t stop at the cookie.

In the story *If You Give a Mouse a Cookie*, the mouse’s one small request triggers a chain reaction: he’ll want milk, then a straw, then a napkin, then to look in a mirror, then scissors to trim his hair… and on and on until you’re stuck meeting endless new demands.

So it’s “a bad idea” because one favor turns into a whole runaway cycle of requests—and you end up right back where you started, with the mouse asking for another cookie.
